security_audit.summary: All 45 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline formatting, documentation links, and metadata URLs. The skill contains no executable commands, network requests, path handling, system reconnaissance, or prompt-injection attempt. It instructs users to treat exports as untrusted and avoid exposing raw PII.

remediation.issue: Static scanners misidentify Markdown backticks as shell execution.
remediation.suggestion: Use indented examples or clearly label code spans as email-template syntax to reduce scanner noise.

remediation.issue: Relative documentation links trigger path-traversal heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Document that these links are repository references, or use a scanner allowlist for Markdown link targets.

content.value_statement: Email templates can fail when data is missing or conditional rules do not match. This skill creates fallback-safe personalization rules and limits visible PII.
actual_capabilities: Maps each merge tag to an available export column.
Defines natural fallback text for missing personalization fields.
Creates named-segment conditional blocks with catch-all branches.
Audits worst-case rendering for empty fields and unmatched segments.
Identifies fields that should not appear in visible email content.
Flags unsupported fields and unapproved promotional claims.
limitations: Does not create audience segments or write the base email copy.
Requires column names, segment definitions, and fill-rate information from the user.
Does not connect to email platforms or synchronize templates automatically.
Does not replace legal, privacy, or final deliverability review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a lifecycle campaign
use_cases.description: Add safe name and product-category personalization to an existing retention email.

use_cases.title: Review cold outreach variables
use_cases.description: Check fallback text and conditional offers before sending a business outreach sequence.

use_cases.title: Design newsletter modules
use_cases.description: Define segment-specific newsletter blocks that always display valid default content.

prompt_templates.title: Add a name fallback
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a first-name merge tag to this email. The available column is first_name. Use a natural fallback.

prompt_templates.title: Map available fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a merge-tag map for this email using first_name, city, and last_category. Include rendered fallbacks and fill-rate concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Create segment variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create conditional blocks for champions, at-risk, and new customers. Include a catch-all branch and preserve the existing email copy.

prompt_templates.title: Run a full safety audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this personalized email for missing fallbacks, unmatched segments, exposed PII, and unsupported promotional claims. Return a personalization specification.

output_examples.input: Use first_name and city in a promotion email. First-name fill rate is 70 percent.
output: Merge-tag map: first_name uses the fallback “there”.
Merge-tag map: city uses the fallback “your area”.
Audit result: both greetings remain readable when fields are empty.

output_examples.input: Show loyalty content to champions and a standard message to everyone else.
output: Conditional rule: champions receive the loyalty block.
Default rule: all other recipients receive the standard block.
Audit result: every recipient receives valid content.

best_practices: Provide a rendered fallback for every merge tag.
Use named segments and include a catch-all conditional branch.
Use aggregate field information instead of raw subscriber records.
anti_patterns: Do not assume an export field is populated without fill-rate evidence.
Do not place full names, addresses, phone numbers, or order identifiers in visible copy.
Do not create promotional claims without approved source wording.

faq.question: Does this skill write a complete email?
faq.answer: No. It personalizes an existing email and does not write the base copy.

faq.question: What input does it need?
faq.answer: Provide the email creative, segment map or columns, campaign mode, and available fill rates.

faq.question: Can it use real subscriber data?
faq.answer: Use column names and aggregate fill rates. Do not provide raw subscriber records or visible PII.

faq.question: What happens when a field is empty?
faq.answer: The skill defines a natural fallback or recommends a conditional block.

faq.question: Does it create audience segments?
faq.answer: No. It requires existing named segments and can flag missing segment definitions.

faq.question: Can it publish a template to an email platform?
faq.answer: No. It produces a specification. Platform synchronization requires a separate approved workflow.
